notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Hi fellow sperms!

We have added some in-game settings, including control settings adjustment. If shaking your mouse is not your prefer way of swimming, No Worry! You could simply press [SPACEBAR] button to swim right now!

Hope you have a fun journey,
Somnolent Team

notes.title: Minor Adjustment Update
notes.content:
Hi fellow sperms, there were some in-game issues that you might be encountering. So, we would like to add some fixes to improve your swimming experience.
[list]
[*] Adjusted swim movement, slightly easier to turn/move around the level
[*] Some sperm cells seems more possible to collect
[*] Fixed some obstacles placement that might get you stuck
[*] Arrow indicator displays when the door is opened
[*] Tail physics adjustment
[*] Fixed sensitivity adjustment
[/list]
